source_generation.reason: Phase 6 measured load/ramp timing tables; physical cell views unchanged

conditions.input_ramp_definition: Full 0–100% linear voltage ramp; synchronized when multiple inputs change.
conditions.delay_reference: Input ideal-step midpoint to output ideal-step midpoint. Full-ramp axis unchanged.
conditions.output_slew_definition: Last directional 10% to 90% crossings of the ideal output step; null for unchanged output or missing crossings.

scope: Isolated extracted devices, ideal input ramps, lumped external C. No multi-input skew characterization.

pdk_provenance.scope: Public pinned PDK; numerical interconnect assumptions are separately labelled.

input_capacitance.method: Biased unloaded-output AC driving-point C from SIM public input_capacitance; no added cell wire C.

interpolation: Only within both measured axes and through passing/non-null samples. No implicit extrapolation.
